findings: All seven saved questions and old/new answers inspected: distinct topics schedule, player eligibility/registration, equipment, penalties and map selection receive only the same section 001 overview; old/new text merely changes line order.

Candidate draft source sections 011, 012, 014, 015 and 054 contain specific clauses relevant to some questions; section 015 has already been addressed by the prior candidate schedule controls. They do not by themselves establish complete answers, event applicability or authority.
The other question types require targeted source mapping and actual candidate probes; source groups must not be treated as semantically identical.

matcher_diagnosis.penalty_observation: Generic Thai penalties/table requests are not among current explicit topics; conditional forfeit_sanctions matches a more specific request only. Section 054 is a table containing multiple offense/penalty conditions; retaining complete paired rows is necessary. Topic recognition alone cannot prove event scope or authority.
matcher_diagnosis.next: Design a general source-text-based penalty table selector; verify complete clause/rows, source edits, forged receipts, other game, named/unnamed event and comparison before claiming fix.

penalty_selector_experiment.observation: Temporary source-topic selector retrieved whole section 054 for both penalty questions. Section 054 ends with an offense without its penalty, while section 055 is a separate permanent-ban fragment. The answer retains the source incompleteness warning but does not associate the fragment; its relation requires independent inspection, not assumption. Temporary selector was reverted pending safe handling and adversarial controls.
